name: DNS Challenge: Deep Noise Suppression Challenge Benchmark
description: The INTERSPEECH 2020 Deep Noise Suppression (DNS) Challenge dataset is an audio benchmark designed to train and benchmark deep learning models on real-time speech enhancement. Providing over 500 hours of clean multi-speaker speech, 180 hours of diverse environmental noise across 150 categories, and 3,000 synthetic room impulse responses.
